statement_as_audited: For any delta>0 and a random GraphVarAlloc instance with n,m tending to infinity, with probability greater than 1-delta, there are Theta(1/p) variables allocated variance Omega(p).

domain.sets: m independently generated Erdos-Renyi incidence sets
domain.edge_probability: p, with no asymptotic restriction stated

quantifiers: random instances as n,m tend to infinity
no fixed-p or np-to-infinity condition appears in the theorem
verdict_rule: FALSIFIED if an allowed p_n sequence makes Theta(1/p_n) variables impossible even before optimization.

counterexample.contradiction: Theta(1/p_n)=Theta(n^2) variables are demanded, but only n variables exist.

scope_note: This falsifies the theorem as written. It does not falsify a repaired fixed-p theorem.
